content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The recruitment notification covers a total of 47 vacancies distributed across two posts under the Medical Health Team (MHT) and RBSK at BPHC and Municipalities of Purba Bardhaman:

rows.category_wise_breakup: UR-14, UR(EC)-6, UR(Meritorious Sportsperson)-1, UR(PwBD)-1, EWS-2, EWS(EC)-2, OBC-2, OBC(EC)-1, SC-8, SC(EC)-2, ST-2

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: FREEJOBALERT DAILY QUIZ Preparing for Govt Exams? Test Yourself! 25 Questions · 20 Minutes · Instant Score Take Today's Free Quiz →

rows.qualification: BHMS/BAMS/BUMS degree from any institution recognised by respective Councils of that stream. Must have completed compulsory internship at the time of submission of application. Registration Certificate of the Respective Council must be obtained. (In case of BHMS: Qualification must be included in the second Schedule of Homoeopathic Central Council ACT 1973; registration required in Part-A of State Register of Homoeopathic Medical Practitioners, West Bengal or Part I of Central Register maintained by Central Council of Homoeopathy. Graded BHMS included.)
Two years Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharma) (ALLOPATHIC) from any institute approved by Pharmacy Council of India (PCI)/AICTE. Registration Certificate must be issued by West Bengal Pharmacy Council.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The post of Medical Officer-AYUSH (MHT) carries a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 32,000 per month, while the Pharmacist post carries a consolidated remuneration of Rs. 22,000 per month. The engagements are purely contractual in nature with an initial period up to March 2027, and may be renewed for further periods depending on satisfactory performance and approval of higher authority.

content_sections.heading: DH&FWS Purba Bardhaman Medical Officer-AYUSH (MHT) Job Description
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will be posted in the Medical Health Team (MHT), RBSK at BPHC and Municipalities of Purba Bardhaman to deliver healthcare services under the National Health Mission (NHM).

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DH&FWS Purba Bardhaman Medical Officer-AYUSH (MHT)
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at www.wbhealth.gov.in and navigate to the online recruitment section. Fill up the online application form with all required personal and academic details. Upload scanned copies of a proper signature and photograph. Deposit the application fee of Rs. 100/- (Rs. 50/- for reserved categories) through NEFT to DISTRICT HEALTH AND FAMILY WELFARE SAMITY (NON-NHM) Bank A/C No- 0187132000008, IFSC- CNRB0000187, or use online payment options. Submit the online application form and download/print a copy of the online registration form ("Application Print") from https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in/Index.aspx for document verification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Print copy of the online application form and online registration form NEFT payment receipt / UTR document / online payment screenshot Proof of age Caste certificate (if applicable) Educational qualification mark sheets and certificates (Class X, Class XII, Degree/Diploma) Registration certificate from the respective council Testimonials in original for verification

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies announced in DH&FWS Purba Bardhaman Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 47 vacancies have been announced, comprising 6 posts of Medical Officer-AYUSH (MHT) and 41 posts of Pharmacist.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to fill up the online application is 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for Medical Officer-AYUSH (MHT)?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a BHMS/BAMS/BUMS degree from a recognised institution, have completed compulsory internship at the time of application, and possess registration with the respective council.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit is 40 years as on 01.01.2026 for Medical Officer-AYUSH, and for Pharmacist, the age limit is minimum 18 years and maximum 40 years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee amount and payment mode?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 100/- for unreserved categories and Rs. 50/- for reserved categories, payable through NEFT or online payment.

faq.question: Q6. How is the selection process conducted?
faq.answer: Selection is made strictly on the basis of marks obtained in academic qualifications and verification of original testimonials.

faq.question: Q7. Are the posts permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The posts are purely contractual in nature with an initial period of engagement up to March 2027, subject to renewal based on performance.

faq.question: Q8. Who is eligible to apply in terms of residency?
faq.answer: Applicants must be permanent residents of West Bengal and must have knowledge of local languages (able to read, write, and speak in Bengali).

faq.question: Q9. What additional weightage is given for higher qualifications?
faq.answer: Persons holding an MD in Homeopathy / Ayurvedic / Unani from a recognised institution will receive additional marks for Medical Officer-AYUSH, and those holding B-Pharma or M-Pharma will receive additional marks for Pharmacist.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the provisional list for testimonial verification be published?
faq.answer: A notice for original testimonial verification along with the provisional list will be published by 20 November 2026 on www.purbabardhaman.nic.in and www.wbhealth.gov.in.
